class.name: CameraRig3D
class.brief_description: A 3D camera rig that follows a target, smoothly adjusts its position, and keeps its camera pointed at the target.
class.description: CameraRig3D is a camera controller that manages a Camera3D node to provide target following, position smoothing, and automatic look-at behavior. The rig can create its own Camera3D child or adopt an existing Camera3D child, depending on [member adopt_existing_camera]. The managed camera is made current when the rig is initialized. The [member target] property specifies the Node3D that the rig follows and looks at. The [member follow_offset] property defines the camera rig's desired position relative to the target. When position smoothing is enabled, the rig moves towards this position gradually instead of snapping to it. CameraRig3D can be used as a foundation for third-person cameras and other camera setups. Mouse input, orbit controls, and obstacle avoidance can be implemented separately or combined with other nodes such as [SpringArm3D].

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the rig uses the first direct child that is a [Camera3D] instead of creating a new camera. If no suitable child is found, a new [Camera3D] is created.
The desired position offset from the target, expressed in the target's local space. The offset is transformed by the target's global transform.
If [code]true[/code], the rig follows the target using [member follow_offset].
If [code]true[/code], the managed camera points towards the target.
If [code]true[/code], the rig smoothly interpolates towards its desired position. Otherwise, it moves directly to the desired position.
Controls how quickly the rig approaches its desired position when [member position_smoothing_enabled] is enabled. Higher values make the rig follow more quickly.
The [Node3D] that the rig follows and looks at. If no target is assigned, target-following and look-at updates are not performed.
